ideas.pitch: A clinical-grade triage and remote photoplethysmography platform that reads heart rates via webcam and categorizes emergency room queues using multilingual LLMs.
ideas.title: AuraCare: Real-Time Patient Triage and rPPG Vitals Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Combines real-time webcam data processing with local inference, matching the exact winning architecture of recent healthcare hackathons like mediscan-ai.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent closed-loop IoT diagnostic platform that detects smart grid and facility energy anomalies and automatically executes mitigation scripts.
ideas.title: SustainGrid: Autonomous IoT Auto-Correction & Anomaly Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages an advanced agentic multi-layered architecture proven to stand out in technical infrastructure hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A computer-vision-based cricket batting and pitching stroke analyzer that evaluates posture and joint alignment using MediaPipe and confidence-gated classification.
ideas.title: BioStance: Cricket Biomechanical Pose Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Presents an instantly engaging live camera demo with rigorous biomechanical scoring, directly mirroring CricketVision_AI.

ideas.pitch: An XGBoost-powered patient readmission predictor featuring SHAP values to give doctors clear, interpretable reasons behind every risk score.
ideas.title: ReadmitPredict: Clinical Explainability Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: Judges appreciate clinical transparency and clear statistical outputs paired with SHAP explainability plots.

ideas.pitch: An interactive medical training simulator where students interview an AI-powered patient evaluated across a strict 6-dimension clinical rubric.
ideas.title: MedInterview Sim: Clinical OSCE Training Platform
ideas.why_it_could_win: Addresses a high-value real-world pain point in medical education with a working multimodal LLM interactive loop.
